text:
I’m passionate, hard-working, and excited to apply for this Virtual Assistant role with your conversion agency.

I bring 6 years of experience working with Python, machine learning, NLP, and automation-focused tools, and I’m comfortable handling research-heavy, detail-oriented tasks with care and consistency. I understand the kind of support a busy agency needs: reliable web research, clean data entry, organized workflows, and clear written communication that helps keep projects moving.

One relevant project I’ve built is a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client. I used Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI to create an assistant that answers questions over 9,000 contracts and always quotes the clause and page it used. The system achieved 0.91 faithfulness on a 120-question lawyer-written test set and reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes. That project strengthened my ability to research carefully, structure information well, and deliver accurate outputs under real-world constraints.

For your role, I can help with thorough web research, lead generation support, maintaining and organizing Google Sheets, crafting concise and engaging emails, and assisting with project management tasks in Asana. I’m comfortable working independently, following instructions closely, and keeping information organized and easy to review. I also understand the importance of clear communication when reaching out to potential candidates and handling operational tasks for a fast-moving team.

I’d be glad to complete your test task and demonstrate my fit for the role. I’m available to contribute and can adapt quickly to your workflow and expectations. If you’re looking for someone dependable, detail-oriented, and easy to work with, I’d love the opportunity to support your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.
